The black rubber window seal and the grey plastic door trim frame the picture; a moulded grab handle runs along the top of the door; the large black wing mirror on its arm pokes into the left edge of the window, beaded with rain. Light sources: the poster panel's cool even backlight, one sodium-orange street lamp above the shelter, our own roof bar's blue strobe flaring across the wet tarmac and the shelter glass, and the reflected glow on raindrops on the window. The near road and kerb streak with motion blur while the poster stays sharp and readable. Cold teal shadows, visible grain, slight halation around the lamp and strobes, no other readable text, no plates or logos. Thanks.
